aiOverview.content: Robert Morris (born c. 1961/1962) is a former Texas megachurch pastor who founded Gateway Church and served as a spiritual advisor to Donald Trump. He resigned in June 2024 following accusations of sexual abuse of a minor in the 1980s. In October 2025, he pleaded guilty to child sexual assault charges, receiving a six-month jail sentence and 9.5 years probation. Key Details Regarding Robert Morris (Pastor): Conviction and Sentencing: Morris pleaded guilty to five counts of indecency with a child. He was sentenced to 180 days (6 months) in the Osage County Jail in Oklahoma, followed by 9.5 years probation. Release: According to reports on March 31, 2026, Morris completed his six-month sentence and was released. Sex Offender Registration: As part of his plea deal, he is required to register as a sex offender. Background: He founded Gateway Church in Southlake, Texas, in 2000, growing it into one of the largest megachurches in the United States. Restitution: He was ordered to pay $270,000 in restitution to the victim. Other notable individuals named Robert Morris include the American Minimalist artist (1931–2018) and the American Revolutionary "Financier" (1734–1806).
